name: user-first-ux
description: How a UI behaves for its users: a priority order (honest > accessible > usable > efficient > consistent > aesthetic), a Read-Report-Plan-Approve-Implement-Verify-Sync workflow, usability reviews, WCAG 2.2 AA audits, dark-pattern and privacy rules, all 30 Laws of UX with Gestalt and a Pass/Fail audit, UI states, forms and flows (checkout, onboarding, enterprise, mobile), EN/BM microcopy and localisation, and user research. Pairs with ui-studio, which owns look, tokens and build.
